Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Thursday — the pilot looks promising and the product team here is aligned. Before we finalize the POC PO I need to resolve two items with our FP&A and legal teams:

1) Payment tempo: our treasury prefers a cadence that starts Net45 but accelerates to Net30 once monthly usage crosses a 3x threshold. Can Redwood support a staged window (Net45 -> Net30) with a capped runway?

2) EU VAT passback: as we're an EU-entity purchasing from a US vendor, our tax team wants clarity on whether Redwood can accept an invoice model where VAT is self-accounted (reverse-charge) and we get corresponding evidence on each invoice.

We also have a short list of asks for conditional credit: a temporary credit buffer during ramp to handle billing spikes, capped at EUR 150k, with clear trigger events and automatic expiration at the pilot end.

I attached a suggested schedule (NexaThera_MATP_schedule_v1.xlsx) to illustrate the cadence. Can you confirm what documentation Redwood needs to enable the VAT reverse-charge and the conditional credit guardrail?

Best,

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear asks and the schedule. We're happy to design a pilot-friendly payment tempo and to support reverse-charge VAT evidence. Quick answers:

- Staged payment window: Yes. We can bill on Net45 for the initial 60 days of the pilot and move to Net30 once the usage threshold you described (3x baseline month) is met for two consecutive billing cycles. We'll record the threshold in the mutual action plan and include automatic reversion clauses if usage drops.

- Conditional credit buffer: We can provision a temporary credit buffer capped at EUR 150,000 for the pilot period. We propose two trigger conditions: (a) one-off spike > 2.5x forecasted month OR (b) three out of four weeks with >35% week-over-week growth. Buffer expires at pilot termination unless extended by mutual written agreement.

- VAT/reverse-charge: Redwood can invoice net of VAT and provide the standard EU reverse-charge wording plus a tax-deduction certificate on each invoice. Finance will need your VAT registration number and a signed billing addendum to enable this flow.

I've attached a draft of the temporary credit buffer term sheet and the billing addendum we typically use for EU reverse-charge buyers. If this looks good, Marissa (finance) and Rishi (credit) are copied for final sign-off.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Wednesday to lock terms and capture any legal redlines.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
